description.value: Side Project Coffee is a campus coffee shop operated by the University of Victoria Graduate Students' Society (GSS), located on the UVic Ring Road campus in Victoria. It shares an organizational home with the Grad House Restaurant, both run as student-facing food and beverage services by the GSS. Touring cyclists on the Galloping Goose or Lochside trails — which connect directly to the UVic area — would find it a convenient on-campus stop for coffee and a rest.
